cohort: Pregnant women admitted to the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology at MKCG Medical College, Berhampur, Odisha, India, between December 2016 and October 2018.
finding: Sickle cell disease (SS) in pregnant women was associated with increased rates of anemia, UTI, painful crisis, pregnancy-induced hypertension, postpartum hemorrhage, and maternal mortality compared to women with sickle cell trait (AS) and controls.
birth_weight: Recorded, but specific values not provided in the abstract.
